description: US/CA-only refactor deny-list (docs/refactor-plan.md Phase 10): removed markets, data sources, and symbols that must not reappear in shipped code. Matched case-insensitively as substrings, scoped to agent/src, agent/backtest, and frontend/src. Intentional mentions belong in `allow` below, each with a non-empty reason; an allow entry suppresses exactly the listed tokens for the matching path (repo-relative path or fnmatch glob). agent/tests/test_us_ca_scope_gate.py enforces both the deny-list and the allowlist's honesty (every entry must carry a reason and must still suppress a real hit).
